name: NXEngine-evo [anylinux]
description:
NXEngine-evo is an upgraded, open-source engine rewrite for Studio Pixel's classic indie platformer Cave Story (Doukutsu Monogatari). It brings the game natively to modern systems with widescreen display and enhanced audio.

Features:
- Full widescreen 16:9 and ultrawide rendering without stretching sprites
- High-definition graphics scaling and support for custom soundtrack arrangements
- Modern gamepad configuration with customizable button layouts and analog support
- Smooth 60 FPS gameplay with fixed physics and jump mechanics
- Full compatibility with original Cave Story freeware data and translations

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
